node.statement: For Z in M_n tensor S_{Q,P}, put W=Z^dagger in M_n tensor S_{P,Q}. The registered self-adjoint operator-space axiom gives ||W||=||Z|| at every level, the definition def-canonical-corner-identifications gives J_{Q,P,n}(Z)=J_{P,Q,n}(W)^dagger, and operator adjunction preserves norm. Applying node 1.1 to W therefore gives both claimed row inequalities with exactly the same constants.
